title: (Pwn2Own) QNAP QHora-322 IPMI Use of Weak Credentials Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of QNAP QHora-322 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the IPMI interface. The issue results from the use of the WAN MAC address as a default password. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the remote management interface.
